PostpartumRecovery.6: Umubiri wawe ukeneye igihe: ivyo bisanzwe hanyuma y'ukubyara.
PostpartumRecovery.9: Iminsi ya mbere: kugenda buhoro no gukira
PostpartumRecovery.12: Kugira ibikorwa n'ugusubira mu bikorwa buhoro buhoro
PostpartumRecovery.19: Iminsi ya mbere: kugenda buhoro no gukira
PostpartumRecovery.22: Kugira ibikorwa n'ugusubira mu bikorwa buhoro buhoro
PostpartumRecovery.28: Igihe cya hanyuma y'ukubyara gikurikira ukubyara. Ntigigarukira ku minsi mike: umubiri, ingene umusi ugenda n'amarangamutima bishobora gukomeza guhinduka buhoro buhoro mu byumweru bikurikira.
PostpartumRecovery.29: “Quarantaine” ni imvugo y'ikinyabuzima ikoreshwa kenshi kugira ngo isobanure ibyumweru vya mbere vy'ugukira. Irashobora kuba urwibutso rwiza: hanyuma yo gutwita no kubyara, ni vyiza kugenda buhoro no guha umubiri igihe.
PostpartumRecovery.31: Gukira bifata umubiri, ariko kandi n'ibitotsi, imbaraga, ingene umusi utegurwa, no kumenyera ikiciro gishasha c'ubuzima.
PostpartumRecovery.32: Iminsi ya mbere irashobora gukomera. Kuruhuka, kwitaho ibisanzwe no kumenyera ingene bishasha akenshi ni vyo vya mbere. Nta mpamvu yo gusubirana ako kanya imbaraga wari usanganywe.
PostpartumRecovery.34: Guhinduranya gukora no kuruhuka bifasha umubiri gukira buhoro buhoro.
PostpartumRecovery.36: Kurya buri gihe no kunywa bijanye n'ivyo ukeneye bishigikira ugukira kwa buri musi.
PostpartumRecovery.38: Kwemera ubufasha bituma ubika imbaraga ku bikenewe n'ugukira.
PostpartumRecovery.40: Subira buhoro buhoro mu bikorwa, wubaha uko umeze n'ukuntu wiyumva.
PostpartumRecovery.41: Ugukira kose kuratandukanye. Impinduka zimwezimwe zishobora kuba mu gihe co kumenyera kandi zikagenda zihinduka buhoro buhoro:
PostpartumRecovery.43: Kuva amaraso agenda agabanuka buhoro buhoro
PostpartumRecovery.45: Ububasha n'igihe cy'ibimenyetso bishobora gutandukana hagati y'umuntu n'uwundi. Ico gihambaye ni ukwitegereza ingene bihinduka no gusaba inama iyo impinduka ibonetse isa n'itera impungenge canke idasanzwe.
PostpartumRecovery.46: Mu gihe cya hanyuma y'ukubyara, ingeso nto, zishoboka akenshi zifasha kuruta gahunda ikomeye. Intumbero ni ugushigikira ugukira utongereye igitutu.
PostpartumRecovery.47: Tegura ibihe vyo kuruhuka vy'ukuri igihe cose bishobotse.
PostpartumRecovery.48: Saba ubufasha mu bikorwa vya buri musi no mu kurya.
PostpartumRecovery.49: Nywa buri gihe kandi ugumane ifunguro ritandukanye.
PostpartumRecovery.50: Irinde kugereranya ugukira kwawe n'ukw'undi muntu.
PostpartumRecovery.51: Subira buhoro buhoro mu bikorwa, utagerageza gukora vyose ako kanya.
PostpartumRecovery.53: Kwizengurukisha abagushigikira no kwemera ubufasha si ibintu vy'akarusho. Vishobora gufasha kubika imbaraga no gutuma ugukira kugenda buhoro buhoro.
PostpartumRecovery.54: Gusubira mu bikorwa bishobora gukorwa intambwe ku yindi, bijanye n'ukuntu wiyumva, imbaraga, n'inama wahawe hanyuma y'ukubyara. Imyitozo yoroshe n'ibikorwa vya buri musi biraharurwa nk'ugusubira mu kugira ibikorwa.
PostpartumRecovery.55: Ku bikorwa bikomeye, ni vyiza gutera imbere udasimbutse intambwe no kwitwararika ibimenyetso canke ububabare bwose.
PostpartumRecovery.57: Ububabare bwiyongera mu gihe c'igikorwa ni impamvu yo kugabanya kandi, nibiba ngombwa, gusaba inama zibereye imbere yo gukomeza canke kongera imbaraga.
PostpartumRecovery.58: Ibitotsi bishobora kuba bidahoraho hanyuma y'ukubyara. Umunaniro wegeranye ushobora kugira ingaruka ku mbaraga, ku kwitwararika no ku marangamutima. Igihe bishoboka, korohereza imirimo imwimwe no gusangira inshingano vyoshobora gufasha.
PostpartumRecovery.62: Ugukira buhoro buhoro n'intangiriro y'ingeso nshasha.
PostpartumRecovery.64: Suzuma iterambere ry'ugukira kandi muvugane ku gusubira buhoro buhoro mu bikorwa.
PostpartumRecovery.65: Igihe cya hanyuma y'ukubyara gishobora kuzana amarangamutima menshi: umunezero, impungenge, umunaniro, ukwumva cane, canke ukumva wuzuye. Ayo marangamutima ashobora guhinduka vuba, cane cane mu gihe ibitotsi n'ingeso za buri musi bihindutse.
PostpartumRecovery.66: Kuvugana n'umuntu wizeye canke n'umuhanga bishobora gufasha iyo amarangamutima ari ngume kuyagenzura canke afata umwanya munini mu buzima bwa buri musi.
PostpartumRecovery.68: Nta mpamvu yo gutegereza ko unanirwa cane canke ukuzura rwose kugira ngo uvuge ukuntu wiyumva kandi usabe ubufasha.
PostpartumRecovery.69: Ibintu bimwebimwe bikwiye kuganirwaho n'umuhanga mu buvuzi, cane cane iyo biba bibi, bigakomeza, canke bigatera impungenge nyinshi.
PostpartumRecovery.71: Ububabare canke ukutumva umerewe neza bwiyongera aho kugabanuka bikwiye inama z'umuhanga.
PostpartumRecovery.73: Kuva amaraso gutunguka kukaba kwinshi canke kudasanzwe bikwiye kubwirwa umuhanga mu buvuzi.
PostpartumRecovery.75: Iyo ububabare bwo mu mutima bufata umwanya munini canke bugatuma ubuzima bwa buri musi buruhanya, ni ngirakamaro kubuvugako no gusaba ubufasha.
PostpartumRecovery.77: Niba ufise gukeka ku gukira kwawe, gusaba inama bigufasha kubona amabwiriza abereye uko umeze.
PostpartumRecovery.78: Amateka yo gukurikiranwa ni akaryo ko kuvuga ku gukira, ibimenyetso, gusubira mu bikorwa, n'ibindi bibazo bisigaye. Gutegura ibibazo bimwebimwe imbere bishobora gufasha ngo nta kintu na kimwe kibagirana.
PostpartumRecovery.80: Ese ugukira kwanje kugenda nk'uko biteganijwe ku miterere yanje?
PostpartumRecovery.81: Ni ibihe bikorwa nshobora gusubiramwo buhoro buhoro?
PostpartumRecovery.83: Ni ryari nshobora gutekereza gusubira mu myitozo ikomeye?
PostpartumRecovery.84: Ese nkeneye inama zihariye canke imyitozo y'ugukira?
PostpartumRecovery.85: Ugukira hanyuma y'ukubyara kugenda buhoro buhoro kandi kuratandukanye kuri buri wese.
PostpartumRecovery.86: Kuruhuka n'ubufasha bishobora kuba igice c'ingenzi c'ugukira.
PostpartumRecovery.87: Impinduka z'umubiri, ibitotsi n'amarangamutima bishobora guhinduka mu byumweru.
PostpartumRecovery.88: Gusubira buhoro buhoro mu bikorwa bigufasha kwubaha neza imbaraga zawe n'ukuntu wiyumva.
PostpartumRecovery.89: Iyo ubonye ikimenyetso kidasanzwe, gikomeje, canke gitera impungenge, gusaba inama ni intambwe nziza.
PostpartumRecovery.91: Gukira si amarushanwa. Gutera imbere buhoro buhoro, wubaha ivyo ukeneye, no gusaba ubufasha igihe bikenewe ni intambwe z'ingenzi.
PostpartumRecovery.92: Iyi nkuru ni iy'ukumenyesha gusa kandi ntisubira mu cimbo c'inama z'ubuvuzi zagenewe wowe. Niba ufise ikimenyetso gikomeye, gikomeje, canke gitera impungenge, vugana n'umuhanga mu buvuzi.

PrayerDuringMenstruation.6: Igituma isalat ihagarikwa muri iki gihe, n'ingene wokibamwo utuje.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.8: Ibi bikubiyemo ni vy'ukwigisha gusa. Ibibazo vy'idini bikwiye kwemezwa n'abahanga babifitiye ububasha. AWA ntitanga fatwa canke ibisubizo vy'idini vyihariye.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.11: Nta kwishura isalat yasigaye, bitandukanye n'igisibo
PrayerDuringMenstruation.14: Mu gihe c'imihango, itegeko ry'isalat rirahagarikwa: umugore ntasabwa gusenga muri iki gihe. Uku guhagarikwa ni igice c'imigenzo y'idini ubwayo, kimaze igihe kimenyekana mu migenzo.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.15: Uku guhagarikwa nta bwo bisobanura kuva mu kwizera canke gutandukira imigenzo y'idini. Ni ukurekurwa kwemewe, kugomba kubaho nta kwiyumvamwo icaha: ni igice c'ishusho karemano y'ubuzima bw'umwuka bw'umugore.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.17: Iki gihe gishobora kwakirwa utuje: nticiyumvisha ko agaciro k'ukwizera canke ugukora ibikorwa vy'idini buri gihe bigabanutse.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.18: Imihango iramutse itangiye isalat iri gukorwa, irahagarara: ntikeneye gusozwa canke kwishurwa. Ahubwo, imihango iyo irangiye, isalat irongera igasubukurwa bisanzwe hanyuma ya ghusl (kwiyuhagira kw'ingenzi), ikaba ikimenyetso c'ugusubira mu mimerere y'isuku y'idini.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.19: Bitandukanye n'igisibo ca Ramadan, iminsi yacitse mu gihe c'imihango yishurwa hanyuma (qadaa), amasalat yacitse kubera iyo mpamvu ubwayo ntakunze kwishurwa hanyuma. Iri tandukaniro risobanurwa n'imiterere y'ibi bikorwa bibiri vyo gusenga: isalat ni igikorwa ca buri musi gisubirwamwo kenshi ku musi, mu gihe igisibo ari ica buri mwaka kandi gikorwa mu kwezi kumwe kwihariye.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.20: Iri tandukaniro rishobora gutangaza igihe ugitangura kumenya fiqh. Ntisobanura ko isalat ifise agaciro gake: gukurikiza urekurwa nk'uko rwashizweho, ubwabyo ni igice rwose c'imigenzo y'idini.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.21: Kudasenga isalat mu gihe c'imihango ntisobanura gutandukana n'ubuzima bwawe bw'umwuka. Ingeri nyinshi z'ugusenga n'ugukora ibikorwa vy'idini ziracashoboka muri iki gihe.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.31: Imigenzo imwimwe, nko gusoma canke gukora ku Quran ku buryo butaziguye, ishobora kugira ibitekerezo bitandukanye bitewe n'ishuri ry'amategeko y'idini. Gusubira ku gitekerezo usanzwe ukurikiza, canke gusaba inama umuhanga abifitiye ububasha, bifasha gusobanura ivyo bibazo.
PrayerDuringMenstruation.33: Isalat ihagarikwa mu gihe c'imihango ni ukurekurwa kwemewe, kugomba kubaho nta kwiyumvamwo icaha. Ingeri nyinshi z'ubuzima bw'umwuka ziracashoboka muri iki gihe, kandi inama y'umuhanga abifitiye ububasha ikomeza kuba ishingiro ku kibazo cose cihariye.

PregnancyExercise.1:
Guguma ukora imyitozo
mu gihe utwite
PregnancyExercise.6: Guguma ukora imyitozo yoroshe, mu mutekano, mu gice cose c'amezi atatu.
PregnancyExercise.13: Kugenda n'amaguru, koga na yoga y'abatwite bisanzwe bisabwa mu gihe cose co gutwita, mu rugero rujanye n'ukuntu wiyumva.
PregnancyExercise.17: Irinde imikino canke ibikorwa bikomeye bishobora gutuma uhaguruka canke ukagwa, cane cane uhereye mu gice ca kabiri c'amezi atatu:
PregnancyExercise.18: Imikino ikomeye (kwiruka cane, imikino y'amaraketi yihuta)
PregnancyExercise.19: Ibikorwa bishobora gutuma ugwa (gusiyera ku rubura, kugendera ku ifarasi, kugendera ku igare ahantu h'ibitari)
PregnancyExercise.21: Imyitozo ikomeye ahantu hirengeye canke mu bushuhe bukabije
PregnancyExercise.23: Ububabare, kuva amaraso, canke gukanda kwa nyababyeyi mu gihe c'imyitozo
PregnancyExercise.25: Buri gihe umve ibimenyetso by'umubiri wawe kandi uvugane n'umubyaza canke muganga imbere yo gutangura canke guhindura igikorwa c'umubiri.
PregnancyExercise.27: Imyitozo yoroshe kandi ihoraho irafasha ku gutwita kwinshi: ingenzi ni ugutunganya ububasha ku kiciro cose no ku ngene wiyumva.
PregnancyExercise.28: Guguma ukora imyitozo mu gihe utwite — AWA

PregnancyWeekly.6: Ibihe vy'ingenzi kuva ku gice ca mbere gushika ku ca gatatu c'amezi atatu, kugira ngo umenye ivyo witeze ku kiciro cose.
PregnancyWeekly.7: Gutwita kwose kugira ingene kugenda: ibi bipimo ni rusangi kandi bishobora gutandukana hagati y'umugore n'uwundi.
PregnancyWeekly.9: Igice ca mbere c'amezi atatu: gushiraho urufatiro
PregnancyWeekly.10: Igice ca kabiri c'amezi atatu: kwumva umerewe neza
PregnancyWeekly.11: Igice ca gatatu c'amezi atatu: kwitegura
PregnancyWeekly.12: Ibihe vy'ingenzi kuri buri gice c'amezi atatu
PregnancyWeekly.16: Igice ca mbere c'amezi atatu gishiraho urufatiro: ingingo zose nkuru z'umwana ziragenda ziremwa buhoro buhoro. Ni n'igihe umunaniro n'isesemi bikunze, mu rugero rutandukanye cane hagati y'abagore.
PregnancyWeekly.18: Ibi bimenyetso, nubwo rimwe na rimwe biruhanya, ni ikimenyetso c'uko umubiri ukomeje kumenyera gutwita.
PregnancyWeekly.19: Igice ca kabiri c'amezi atatu akenshi ni co cegereye cane, ari na ho ukwimuka kwa mbere k'umwana kuboneka.
PregnancyWeekly.21: Bikunze kumvikana hagati y'ibyumweru 18 na 22, hakiri kare gato iyo atari ugutwita kwawe kwa mbere.
PregnancyWeekly.22: Igice ca gatatu c'amezi atatu gitegura umubiri ku kubyara, ufise ukwiyongera kw'uburemere n'umunaniro bigaragara cane. Ukwikanda kwa nyababyeyi kw'imyitozo (kwitwa Braxton Hicks) gushobora kandi kuboneka.
PregnancyWeekly.23: Uku kwikanda gukunze kutaba guhoraho kandi guke kubabaza; gutandukanye n'ukwikanda kw'ukuvuka.
PregnancyWeekly.24: Igice ca 1 c'amezi atatu: kuremwa kw'ingingo
PregnancyWeekly.25: Igice ca 2 c'amezi atatu: ukwimuka kwa mbere
PregnancyWeekly.26: Igice ca 3 c'amezi atatu: kwitegura kubyara
PregnancyWeekly.28: Isesemi n'umunaniro, cane cane mu gice ca mbere c'amezi atatu
PregnancyWeekly.29: Ububabare buto mu nda buhujwe no kurambura kw'imitsi
PregnancyWeekly.30: Guhema bigoye gato mu ntango y'ukwezi kwa nyuma
PregnancyWeekly.31: Ingorane z'ibitotsi mu gice ca nyuma c'amezi atatu ya nyuma
PregnancyWeekly.32: Ibimenyetso bimwebimwe bisaba inama z'ubuvuzi vuba, mu gice cose c'amezi atatu:
PregnancyWeekly.36: Kuribwa umutwe bikomeye canke ingorane zo kubona
PregnancyWeekly.39: Igice cose c'amezi atatu kizana impinduka zacyo: kuzimenya hakiri kare bigufasha kubaho neza buri kiciro, bitisubiriye mu cimbo c'ugukurikiranwa buri gihe n'umubyaza canke muganga.
PregnancyWeekly.40: Gutwita kwawe, icyumweru ku cyumweru — AWA

RamadanFasting.6: Impanuro zifatika n'amakuru y'ukwigisha kugira ngo ubeho ukwezi kwa Ramadan uri mu mihango, utuje.
RamadanFasting.8: Ibi bikubiyemo ni vy'ukwigisha gusa. Ibibazo vy'idini bikwiye kwemezwa n'abahanga babifitiye ububasha. AWA ntitanga fatwa canke ibisubizo vy'idini vyihariye.
RamadanFasting.10: Igisibo gihagarikwa mu gihe c'imihango yawe
RamadanFasting.14: Mu gihe c'imihango yawe, igisibo nticisabwa: iki gihe gishira umugore mu mimerere aho ibikorwa bimwebimwe vyo gusenga, harimwo n'igisibo, bihagarikwa by'igihe gito. Uku guhagarikwa kumenyekana nk'ugutuza, atari nk'ukubuzwa canke igihano.
RamadanFasting.15: Guhagarika igisibo mu gihe c'imihango yawe ntibisobanura kuva mu migenzo yawe y'idini. Bihagarara gusa mu gihe kigufi, hanyuma bigasubukurwa bisanzwe imihango irangiye, nta gikorwa c'ukwizera gitakaye. Iminsi itasibwe izishurwa hanyuma (qadaa), hanze ya Ramadan.
RamadanFasting.17: Iki gihe cokwakirwa kandi nk'ubundi bwoko bw'igihe mu kwezi, aho iby'umwuka bikomeza kugaragara mu zindi nzira, nta gisibo.
RamadanFasting.19: Iyi mimerere ntikwiye kubamwo kwiyumvamwo icaha: ni igice c'uruzinduko karemano rw'umubiri kandi imigenzo y'idini ubwayo yarabitekerejeko.
RamadanFasting.20: Kudasiba ntibisobanura gutandukana n'ukwezi kwa Ramadan. Ingeri nyinshi z'iby'umwuka ziracashoboka kandi zigufasha gukomeza kubaho iki gihe rwose.
RamadanFasting.30: Ibi bikorwa bito, naho vyoba byoroshe, bigufasha kuguma uhujwe rwose n'umwuka w'ukwezi, uko wama umeze kwose.
RamadanFasting.31: Gukurikirana iminsi y'imihango yawe mu gihe ca Ramadan bituma nyuma woroherwa no kubara iminsi yo kwishura (qadaa), kandi bikurinda gushingira ku kwibuka ukwezi kurangiye.
RamadanFasting.32: Andika itariki ya buri musi utasibye uko bigenda
RamadanFasting.33: Koresha kalendari, porogaramu, canke ikayi yabigenewe
RamadanFasting.34: Subiramwo vuba ku musozo w'ukwezi kugira ngo ugenzure igitigiri cose
RamadanFasting.36: AWA irashobora kugufasha gukurikirana uruzinduko rwawe mu gihe cose ca Ramadan, kugira ngo nyuma ubone ayo makuru byoroshe.
RamadanFasting.38: Ingene nyayo yo kwishura iminsi yacitse (igihe, imimerere yihariye nko gutwita canke konsa) ishobora gutandukana bitewe n'ishuri ry'amategeko y'idini. Ku mimerere yihariye canke ikomeye, igitekerezo cy'umuhanga abifitiye ububasha gikomeza kuba ishingiro.
RamadanFasting.40: Igisibo gihagarikwa mu gihe c'imihango yawe ni ugutuza kwemewe, si ukuruhuka ku migenzo yawe y'idini. Kubaho iki gihe mu buryo butandukanye, gukurikirana iminsi yawe, no gusaba amabwiriza igihe ufise gukeka, vyose bigufasha kunyuramwo Ramadan utuje.
RamadanFasting.41: Igisibo mu gihe ca Ramadan — AWA

RegularIrregularCycle.1:
Uruzinduko ruhoraho canke rudahoraho:
ni irihe tandukaniro?
RegularIrregularCycle.4: Uruzinduko rw'imihango rwose ruratandukanye. Gusobanukirwa icitwa “gisanzwe” bishobora kugufasha gukurikirana ubuzima bwawe neza no kubona ukudahwana gushoboka.
RegularIrregularCycle.11: Uruzinduko ruraharurwa nk'uruhoraho iyo uburebure bwarwo buri hagati y'iminsi 21 na 35, n'itandukaniro riri munsi y'iminsi 7 hagati y'uruzinduko n'urundi.
RegularIrregularCycle.13: Icingenzi ni ukwitegereza ingene ugenda wowe uko amezi ahita.
RegularIrregularCycle.15: Umugore wese aratandukanye. Icingenzi ni ukumenya ingene ugenda wowe n'impinduka zisanzwe zawo.
RegularIrregularCycle.16: Uruzinduko ruraharurwa nk'urudahoraho iyo uburebure bwarwo butandukana kenshi canke mu buryo budateganijwe (itandukaniro rirenga iminsi 7). Bishobora kugaragara nk'inzinduko ngufi cane, ndende cane, canke kutagira ovulation.
RegularIrregularCycle.18: Ayo matandukaniro ashobora kuba y'igihe gito canke agakomeza mu nzinduko nyinshi.
RegularIrregularCycle.20: Ukudahoraho kw'igihe gito gushobora kuba gusanzwe (umunaniro wo mu mutima, impinduka za hormone, umunaniro w'umubiri…). Ariko iyo gukomeje, ni ngirakamaro gushakisha igitera.
RegularIrregularCycle.24: Uburemere buri hasi cane canke buri hejuru cane
RegularIrregularCycle.26: Kutagira imihango amezi arenga 3 (hatarimwo igihe co gutwita/konsa)
RegularIrregularCycle.27: Inzinduko ndende cane (iminsi irenga 90) canke ngufi cane (iminsi iri munsi ya 21)
RegularIrregularCycle.29: Kuva amaraso menshi cane canke adahoraho
RegularIrregularCycle.30: Niba ugerageza gutwita kandi ovulation isa nk'itaba
RegularIrregularCycle.36: Uruzinduko ruhoraho canke rudahoraho: ni irihe tandukaniro? — AWA

ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.6: Ingingo zimwezimwe z'ubuyobozi bw'umwuka zigufasha kunyuramwo igihombo ufise ubuntu, kwihangana n'impuhwe.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.8: Ibi bikubiyemo ni vy'ukwigisha. Ibibazo vy'idini vyihariye bikwiye kugenzurwa n'umuhanga abifitiye ububasha. AWA ntitanga fatwa zihariye.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.13: Ingingo zimwezimwe z'ubuyobozi zo gutera imbere
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.15: Igihombo c'inda gishobora kuba ikigeragezo kibabaza cane. Agahinda, guceceka, kuzinagurika, canke gukenera kwitandukanya ni ibisubizo vya kamere vy'umuntu.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.16: Kwumva ayo marangamutima ntibisobanura kubura ukwizera. Umugore wese ashobora kunyuramwo agahinda ke ku muvuduko we.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.19: 2. Imimerere ishobora gutandukana bitewe n'uko bimeze
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.20: Hanyuma y'igihombo, amategeko y'idini ashobora guterwa n'uko bimeze n'imiterere y'ukuva amaraso.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.21: Cane cane, bishobora kuba ngombwa gutandukanya ubwoko butandukanye bw'ukuva amaraso imbere yo kumenya ibikorwa vy'idini ukwiye gukurikiza.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.27: Imimerere y'umuntu ku giti ciwe ishobora gusaba igisubizo gitandukanye. Ni vyiza gusaba inama umuntu abifitiye ububasha.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.29: Kwihangana (sabr) ntibisobanura kudatinya kurira canke kudahura n'ububabare. Bishobora gusa guherekeza urugendo ufise ukwizera n'icizere.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.30: Ibikorwa bito bishobora gufasha kugarura buhoro buhoro amahoro: gusaba, akanya ka dhikr, kumva iby'umwuka, canke kuba uri kumwe n'uwo ukunda.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.35: Gukira bifata igihe. Nta muvuduko umwe wagenewe bose wo kunyuramwo igihombo.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.36: 4. Ingingo zimwezimwe z'ubuyobozi zo gutera imbere
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.37: Nta mpamvu yo gukora vyose icarimwe. Hitamwo ivyo bijanye n'ukuntu wiyumva n'ivyo ukeneye ubu.
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.38: Fata igihe cyo kunyuramwo agahinda kawe
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.40: Komeza imigenzo mito y'iby'umwuka niba ikuzanira ihumure
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.41: Saba inama ku kibazo cose cihariye c'idini
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.42: Saba ubufasha iyo agahinda kabaye ngume kwikorera
ReligiousFaqAfterLoss.44: Kwiyitaho, gusaba ubufasha no kugumana icizere bishobora gufasha buhoro buhoro kuyobora inzira igana amahoro.

ReligiousFaq.1:
Ibibazo bibazwa kenshi
ku bijanye na fiqh y'abagore
ReligiousFaq.6: Ibibazo bikunze kubazwa ku bijanye na fiqh y'abagore, vyegeranijwe hamwe n'ibisubizo bisobanutse.
ReligiousFaq.8: Ibi bikubiyemo ni vy'ukwigisha gusa. Ibibazo vy'idini bikwiye kwemezwa n'abahanga babifitiye ububasha. AWA ntitanga fatwa canke ibisubizo vy'idini vyihariye.
ReligiousFaq.14: Ibibazo vyinshi ku ruzinduko, isalat n'igisibo bivuka buri gihe hagati y'umugore n'uwundi. Dore ibisubizo rusangi ku bikunze cane; kugira ngo ubirabire cane, buri ngingo kandi irasobanuwe cane mu nkuru yayo yihariye.
ReligiousFaq.16: Fiqh y'abagore ihuza amategeko afatika yerekeye cane cane imibiri y'abagore n'ugusenga kwabo: uruzinduko, isuku, isalat, igisibo, nifas na istihâda.
ReligiousFaq.17: Ni izihe ngingo nkuru fiqh y'abagore ikubiyemo?
ReligiousFaq.18: Ikubiyemo cane cane imihango n'uruzinduko, isuku y'idini, ghusl, isalat n'igisibo mu gihe n'hanyuma y'imihango, nifas na istihâda.
ReligiousFaq.19: Irihe tandukaniro riri hagati y'imihango, ukuva amaraso hanyuma y'ukubyara, n'ukuva amaraso kudahoraho?
ReligiousFaq.20: Imihango (hayd) ikurikira uruzinduko rusanzwe, nifas iba hanyuma y'ukubyara, naho istihâda yerekana ukuva amaraso kudahoraho, hanze y'uruzinduko. Buri kimwe gikurikiza imimerere itandukanye.
ReligiousFaq.21: Isalat iba iki mu gihe c'imihango?
ReligiousFaq.22: Isalat irahagarikwa muri iki gihe: ni ukurekurwa kwemewe, kugomba kubaho nta kwiyumvamwo icaha.
ReligiousFaq.23: Igisibo kiba iki mu gihe c'imihango?
ReligiousFaq.24: Igisibo kirahagarikwa na co; iminsi itasibwe yishurwa hanyuma (qadaa), hanze ya Ramadan.
ReligiousFaq.25: Kubera iki isalat yacitse itishurwa muri rusangi, bitandukanye n'igisibo?
ReligiousFaq.26: Iri tandukaniro rituruka ku miterere y'ibi bikorwa bibiri: isalat ni iya buri musi kandi isubirwamwo, mu gihe igisibo ari ica buri mwaka kandi gikorwa mu kwezi kumwe. Gukurikiza urekurwa ni igice rwose c'imigenzo y'idini.
ReligiousFaq.28: Imihango iyo irangiye kandi ghusl ikaba yakozwe, isalat irongera igasubukurwa bisanzwe, nta gutinda.
ReligiousFaq.30: Ghusl ni kwiyuhagira kw'ingenzi gutuma umuntu asubira mu mimerere y'isuku y'idini ikenewe kugira ngo asubukure isalat n'ibindi bikorwa vyo gusenga.
ReligiousFaq.31: Woba gute iyo utazi neza ko imihango yarangiye?
ReligiousFaq.32: Kwitegereza ko nta maraso akiboneka rwose mu gihe gihagije, aho gushingira ku kwiyumvira kw'akanya gato, bifasha gusobanura uko bimeze.
ReligiousFaq.33: Izindi ngeri z'ugusenga zishobora gukorwa mu gihe c'imihango?
ReligiousFaq.34: Yego: dhikr, gusaba, ubugiraneza, kwiga iby'idini n'ibindi bikorwa vyiza biracashoboka.
ReligiousFaq.35: Kubera iki ibisubizo bimwebimwe bishobora gutandukana bitewe n'uko bimeze?
ReligiousFaq.36: Fiqh ni ahantu h'ugusobanura: ibitekerezo bishobora gutandukana bitewe n'ishuri ry'amategeko y'idini n'imimerere y'umuntu, nta gitekerezo kimwe cyonyine kiba intangarugero ku bwacyo.
ReligiousFaq.37: Fiqh ya Kisilamu irimwo amatandukaniro yemewe y'ugusobanura ku ngingo zimwezimwe z'utuntu. Ayo matandukaniro amaze ibinyejana kandi aharurwa ko yemewe mu migenzo y'idini.
ReligiousFaq.38: Bitewe n'isoko wagishije inama, ikibazo kimwe gishobora rero kubona ibisubizo bitandukanye gato. Ntibisobanura ko igisubizo cogaragara nk'ikitari co ako kanya: kigaragaza uburyo butandukanye n'ukuntu isoko imwe isomwa.
ReligiousFaq.40: Gukurikiza buri gihe isoko ibifitiye ububasha, aho guhindura igitekerezo gusa bitewe n'igisubizo cose kibonetse, bifasha kugumana imigenzo yawe isobanutse kandi ituje.
ReligiousFaq.41: Ibintu bimwebimwe biracaruhanya gukemurwa hashingiwe ku busobanuro rusangi bumwe. Ni ko biri cane cane igihe:
ReligiousFaq.42: Hari gukeka ku gihe imihango yarangiriye koko
ReligiousFaq.43: Imiterere y'ukuva amaraso iracari ikibazo (imihango, istihâda, ikindi)
ReligiousFaq.44: Gukeka kuguma ku bijanye n'ukwiye gukora ghusl
ReligiousFaq.45: Ikibazo co gusubukura isalat kiracari ikibazo
ReligiousFaq.46: Hamenyekanye amakuru atavuga rumwe kuri interineti
ReligiousFaq.48: Iyo ikibazo ari c'umuntu ku giti ciwe, gikomeye, canke gikomeje, ntigishobora gukemurwa n'amakuru rusangi. Kwitabaza umuhanga abifitiye ububasha, ashobora kwitwararika imimerere yawe yihariye, biguma ari inzira nziza muri ico gihe. AWA ntitanga fatwa canke ibisubizo vy'idini vyihariye.
ReligiousFaq.49: Fiqh y'abagore ikubiyemo ingeri nyinshi z'imigenzo y'idini y'abagore
ReligiousFaq.50: Utuntu tumwetumwe dushobora gutandukana mu buryo bwemewe bitewe n'ishuri ry'amategeko y'idini
ReligiousFaq.51: Amakuru rusangi ntasubira mu cimbo c'ubuyobozi bw'idini bwihariye
ReligiousFaq.52: Gukeka gukomeje gukwiye kubwirwa umuhanga abifitiye ububasha
ReligiousFaq.53: Uruhara rwa AWA ni urw'ukwigisha, si urwo gutanga fatwa
ReligiousFaq.54: Ibibazo bibazwa kenshi ku bijanye na fiqh y'abagore — AWA
